en: A typical cumulus cloud contains about 1.1 million pounds of water, weighing roughly as much as 100 elephants.
It takes nature up to 500 years to naturally produce just one single inch of fertile topsoil.
Diamonds and the graphite in your pencil lead are both made of the exact same pure carbon element.
The water you drink today contains molecules that have continuously recycled through the water cycle since dinosaur times.
Because Venus rotates extremely slowly in the opposite direction, a single day on Venus is longer than its year.
The red supergiant star Betelgeuse is so massive that it would swallow Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars if placed in our solar system.
Astronaut footprints on the Moon will remain perfectly preserved for millions of years because there is no wind or water to erode them.
Mount Taal in the Philippines features a main crater lake that contains a smaller island with its own active volcano.
A single mature typhoon releases heat energy equivalent to 10,000 nuclear bombs exploding every twenty minutes.
The eye of a severe typhoon is a surprisingly calm, clear area completely surrounded by the storm's most violent winds.
Pumice is the only natural rock on Earth that is light and porous enough to float on water.
Most meteorites that land on Earth are actually older than our planet because they formed at the solar system's very beginning.
